device.model: HD X7 Combo (System ID 06000200, SAB XWindow GUI 1.5.53)
device.type: DVB-S2 + DVB-T / Twin Full HD satellite & terrestrial combo receiver with VFD, 2x CA, 2x CI
device.board: 06000200 (Globo / Opticum M3602A "Lemontree" VFD platform with EuP standby MCU)
device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB0 / SCB1 at I2C 0x33 (+ COFDM DVB-T probe at I2C 0x11)
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 DVB-S2 on SCB0 / SCB1 at I2C 0x60

source.author: SAB / Globo (gisclub.tv XWindow GUI mod)
source.note: Archive globo_x7_xwindow_sab_1.5.53_gisclub.tv.rar from the Opticum / Opticum HD X402-X403-X4-X7 directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-03.

simulator.note: Boots as an M3602A board (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_globo_x7_xwindow_1553_app_starts.py, run_dump_globo_x7_xwindow_1553_capture_screen.py): the "M3602A 1.1.6" bootloader prints "APP  init ok", exchanges CRC-16/XMODEM transactions and 38-byte PT6311 8-character 14-segment VFD frames with the external Lemontree EuP standby and VFD microcontroller at I2C 0x28 over bit-banged GPIO 62 (SCL) / 171 (SDA), unpacks the 8.14 MB maincode(AV) to 0x80008000 and enters the application.  The application configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60 on SCB0 and SCB1, and renders its SAB XWindow OSD dialog through GeM3602.

desc: Globo / Opticum HD X7 Combo (System ID 06000200) firmware 1.5.53 with the SAB XWindow GUI (2011-12-30) on a 4 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3602A Full HD combo/twin receiver with 2x CA and 2x CI.

Drives an 8-character 14-segment PT6311 VFD display through the external Lemontree EuP standby microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on GPIO 62 / 171 using 38-byte op-0x33 CRC-16/XMODEM frames, alongside ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator(s) at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner(s) at I2C 0x60.
